context: Tests whether the solution correctly implements priority-based template resolution as provided by specify-cli's preset system. When multiple installed presets supply a template with the same name, the preset with the lowest numeric priority value must win, with list order as a tiebreaker. The rubric rewards correct priority comparison, tiebreaker handling, and appropriate error raising.

checklist.name: Single preset resolution
checklist.description: Correctly retrieves template content from the sole installed preset using specify-cli's preset resolution API.

checklist.name: Priority ordering
checklist.description: When multiple presets supply the same template name, the preset with the numerically lower priority value is selected.

checklist.name: Tiebreaker by order
checklist.description: When two presets share the same priority, the one appearing first in installation order is selected.

checklist.name: Missing template error
checklist.description: Raises TemplateNotFoundError (or equivalent specify-cli exception) when no installed preset provides the requested template name.
